newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Mirabell seen strong on Friday debut.
newsitem.headline: HK's Mirabell seen strong on Friday debut.

text.p: Footwear retailer Mirabell International Holdings Ltd should notch sharp gains on its stock market debut on Friday due to a strong subscription response and hopes of a pick up in consumer spending, analysts said.
"I think the shares have the potential to rise as high as double their issue price in view of the strong subscription response," said Kinson Au, senior analyst at PW Asia Brokerage.
The initial public offering of 60 million shares was priced at HK$1.22 per share and was 190.5 times subscribed.
Analysts said the grey market price for Mirabell shares was about HK$2.00 per share.

"Anticipation of a recovery of the Hong Kong retail sector and expectations of a pick up in consumer spending ahead of the (Christmas and New Year) holidays, are also expected to fuel trading interest or give investors an excuse to buy consumer stocks," said Michael Ng, analyst at ASG Investment.
Mirabell, which will have a market capitalisation of HK$293 million, operates retail footwear outlets.
The company said the proceeds of the issue would be used to set up new outlets, buy a warehouse and administrative offices in Hong Kong, repay bank loans and for general working capital.
